## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] `make fmt lint test test-dbus` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] `docs/` and `README.md` updated if flags, options or behaviour changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` for user-visible changes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or tailnet details in code, tests or logs
